# Reference titles — woodworking (distilled)

Proven titles per cluster with views and age, and the lesson each taught. Always loaded. Performance is read against each source channel's own normal; multiplier badges were dropped (raw file in `archive/`). Produced titles live in `produced-log.md`; the format status each title proves lives in `steering.md`.

## Table of contents
1. Own winners (Dale Oakfield's Workshop)
2. Woodworking ecosystem by topic cluster

4. Adjacent lane: trim and finish carpentry

6. Woodworking-for-profit ecosystem (Dale / Hank intake, observed 2026-06-22)

## 1. Own winners (assigned to Dale as the working assumption — reassign if the operator says otherwise)

The only two own woodworking videos above 10k across many tests:
- 10 AMAZING Woodworking Tips That Actually Work — 18k / 2 weeks
- 12 GENIUS Woodworking Tips Every Beginner Should Use — 14k / 4 days

**Lessons:** one format proven (F3: numbered tips listicle + one caps power word + qualifying tail); zero specific topics proven ("woodworking tips" is a bucket). "Every Beginner Should Use" confirms the beginner skew — bias toward prohibition (F1), mistakes (F9), you're-doing-it-wrong (F6) and shortcut secrets. The generic-tips ceiling is ~18k; breaking it means a specific high-demand topic wrapped in an exaggerated format. The thumbnails did the clicking with a sharp specific hook ("STOP GLUE STAINS") while the title stayed broad — keep the pattern, and promote strong thumbnail hooks into dedicated titles.

## 2. Woodworking ecosystem by topic cluster ("channels your audience watches")

- **Scrap / offcut / waste wood (biggest cluster — 3 signals):** The best waste projects in your workshop. Woodworking. — 2.1M / 3y (old + huge = durable pool); 5 Tiny Scrap Wood Projects You Didn't Think About — 144k / 1y (recent format to keep and exaggerate); Easy Woodworking Projects. DIY. — 1M / 4y (durable, generic — re-package with a sharper format).
- **Sawdust uses:** 13 Things You Can Do With Sawdust You Haven't Thought Of — 357k / 1y ("Don't Throw It Away" thumbnail). Feeds F25 / F26 / F24.
- **Workshop jigs / devices:** The best devices for the workshop. Woodworking. — 2M / 3y (old + huge; re-packaged into F3 / F2 in the June batch).
- **Table-saw upgrades:** Top 16 Table Saw Upgrades from 50 Years Experience — 383k / 2y ("99% DON'T KNOW THESE" thumbnail). Keep the format, escalate the count, add F6 / F33.
- **Wood joints:** see §3.
- **Bad mitres / gap-filling:** Old School Tricks To Make Bad Mitres Look Amazing! — 1.5M / 2y (F19 proven in woodworking; absorbs caulking-gap demand into the craft lane).
- **Cutting boards / finishes:** Stop Using Mineral Oil for Cutting Boards and Utensils! — 1.3M / 3y (F33; spawns F32 truth, F1 never-finishes, F27 longer-lasting, F22 pro-secret angles).
- **Tool buying (monetizes best):** Expensive Woodworking Tools Beginners Actually Need — 132k / 1y (WORTH IT thumbnail; F28 + value verdict); ecosystem parallel Watch This Before You Spend Thousands on Flooring! — 543k / 3 mo (F8, transfers to tools).
- **Seasonal / cheap-lumber builds:** 5 DIY Christmas Builds in Under 5 Hours Using Only Wood from Lowes — 144k / 7 mo (F30 + named retailer + seasonal; Dale-only register; swap the occasion year-round).
- **Beginner mistakes / amateur-vs-pro:** see §3 and §4.

## 3. The standout outlier

**I Don't Get Why People Still Use These Joints — 3.3M / 1y.** The biggest outlier in the pool and the source of F36 (first-person contrarian dismissal); "DON'T DO IT" thumbnail. Wood joints are proven at a 3M+ ceiling; the contrarian-opinion framing beat every listicle in the set. Re-attackable on all three channels.

## 6. Woodworking-for-profit ecosystem (Dale / Hank intake, observed 2026-06-22, banked 2026-09-09)

74 winners from 14 creators plus outliers; raw set in `archive/hank-hardwood-intake-2026-06.md`. Read for the for-profit channels (Dale Oakfield's Workshop, Hank Hardwood). Multiplier badges dropped; raw views only; channel normals unknown.

- **One cheap unit → many products (F30 / F41 — the biggest lane):** This only takes Three 2x4s. Huge Profit — 4.1M / 3y (Brady Hommel; the set's biggest single winner); Use PALLETWOOD to make MONEY and learn woodworking. — 2.6M / 3y (Dainer Made); I cannot make these FAST ENOUGH. $45 each. Nineteen products from ONE 2X4. — 2.1M / 1y (WhosTheVoss — three hooks stacked: demand-overload + per-unit price + yield); One 2x4 Spiral Tree - Low Cost High Profit - Make Money Woodworking — 1.0M / 3y (Matthew Peech). **Lesson:** extreme material constraint plus a money payoff is the niche's core engine; yield counts (19, 32) and dollar outputs (Turning one 2x6 into $150 — 389k / 5y) both work.
- **Demand-overload (F51 — five channels):** The Woodworking Project I Can't Stop Selling (Unfortunately) — 1.7M / 3y (Hamilton Dilbeck); Easy Woodworking Projects that sell like Hotcakes ???? Really ?? — 1.1M / 1y, So many orders for this Build ! — 536k / 2 mo, Non stop orders / woodworking — 397k / 3 mo, I literally sold out ! Woodworking projects that sell fast ! — 221k / 3 mo (Bearded Viking — the recent cluster); wood turning - these sell as fast as I can make them — 487k / 1y (RC Woodturning). **Lesson:** certainty of sale is the money-motivated viewer's deepest doubt; overwhelm answers it. The most recent uploads in the set leaned on it hardest.
- **Waste material → money (F26 money-key):** Everyone Throws Sawdust Away...Here's How to SELL IT! — 1.7M / ~4 weeks (WhosTheVoss — the hottest live signal on the observation date); You'll Never Throw Away Cardboard Boxes again . Amazing Idea ! (Bearded Viking, views cropped); wood turning twigs into hot selling items — 974k / 2y (RC); Easy to Make. Easier to Sell. All from Scrap Wood You Already Have. — 659k / 1y (WhosTheVoss). **Lesson:** "sell it" outperforms "use it" on the same material; zero-cost inputs are their own hook.
- **Arbitrage gap (F52):** They Want $1800...You Can Build It For $26 — 654k / 2y (Matthew Peech); People Are Selling These Crosses for $475 (I Made One for $20) — 235k / 6 mo (Jasco Goods); the honest-accounting variant I buy ALL the tools to build it, and still profit $100. — 956k / 1y (WhosTheVoss). **Lesson:** the multiple, not the price, is the hook; preempting the tool-cost objection is its own expression.
- **Earned-income figures (the money-in scale):** Woodworking Side Hustle – $4,000/Month (Free Plans!) — 2.3M / 2y (Salty Woodworking) and its one-digit clone Woodworking Side Hustle - $4,001/Month (Free Plans!) — 475k / 2y (WhosTheVoss); 650% Profit - Make Money Woodworking - Full Build — 945k / 4y; wood turning 100 bucks an hour with scrap 2x6 — 805k / 1y; Make $75 in Under 1 Hour With This Simple Bench Build! (Step by Step DIY Build) — 672k / 1y (Fish Over Chicks); This 5 Minute Project Makes Money Fast! — 797k / 9 mo (F42). **Lesson:** creators in this niche clone each other's winners with a digit changed — the recreate-and-enhance method is native here. The operator killed the hourly-wage framing on the own channels; per-project, per-month and margin figures stay.
- **Projects-that-sell listicles (F3 + sell-framing):** Top 5 Woodworking Projects That Sell — 2.1M / 5y (731 Woodworks); Make Money Woodworking! My Top 5 Most Profitable Projects That Sell! (Episode 1) — 1.2M / 4y and Low Cost High Profit - Small Projects That Sell - Make Money Woodworking (Episode 2) — 3.1M / 4y (Matthew Peech); Easy Beginner Woodworking projects that sell for High Profit — 1.7M / 1y (Jasco Goods); 40 Woodworking Projects That Sell! (DIY PROJECTS) — 387k / 4y and 100 Woodworking Projects (SELL THESE PROJECTS!) — 249k / 1y (Fish Over Chicks); 100+ Pallet Projects To Start a Small Business For Beginners — 750k / 2y (outlier). **Lesson:** counts of 40–100+ carry the compilation format; "3" and "5" counts were the era, not the ceiling — amplify.
- **The Matthew Peech franchise model:** fourteen winners built from four reusable modules — `[The $X Product]` + `Low Cost High Profit` + `Make Money Woodworking` + `(Episode N)` — plus `[N] More … That Sell - [Wedding / Fall] Edition` (376k / 316k) as the serialized listicle. **Lesson:** a modular suffix system sustains a whole for-profit channel; candidate series brand for the own channels.
- **Product winners (topic bank):** planters are the repeat champion — The $6 Planter - Low Cost High Profit - Make Money Woodworking — 1.6M / 4y, its Version 2 — ~697k, The Easiest DIY Planter box! - Under $5 to build! - How To — 401k / 4y, DIY $10 Tall Planter — 322k; bird feeders — The $8 Martin Box - Projects That Sell - Make Money Woodworking — 741k / 3y, THE $6 COVERED BRIDGE BIRD FEEDER / MAKE MONEY WOODWORKING — 287k / 1y; cutting boards — I don't get why people think selling cutting boards is hard? — 390k / 3y (F36 on a selling myth); the American flag — How to Make a Waving American Flag for $5 // HUGE PROFIT! — 228k / 1y; engraving — EASY projects to engrave and sell FAST — 509k / 2y; coffee tables — Coffee table that SELLS very well made from Palletwood — 295k / 6y; the decision gate — Should You Sell Your Woodworking Projects? — 387k / 3y (Hamilton Dilbeck).
- **Two title philosophies in the pool:** hook-driven (everything above) and SEO-stacked — Wooden craft ideas and scrap wood projects ideas to make money fast as a woodworker — 1.0M / 3y (5-Minute Projects). Both earn views; the own channels run hook-driven (browse).
